stableTraits.Jesus: Brown complexion, natural dark curls, full beard, angular nose, lean adult; ministry and resurrection accounts do not require extra aging. No new Acts portrait.
stableTraits.Peter: Acts 3/4 dark curls, full beard, medium-brown complexion, lean adult; Acts 10 has modest grey compatible with elapsed years. Pentecost v1 white-haired/white-bearded portrait is rejected as inconsistent with the next scene. Gospel face naming remains limited to text/action, not garments.
stableTraits.PaulSaul: Acts 9 seated Saul has medium-brown complexion, natural dark curls, dark beard, adult build. Acts 16/17/21/24/27 maintain an adult dark-curled bearded man with plausible modest aging. Acts 13 v1 receding greying hair and older face conflict with later depictions; replace without portraits.
stableTraits.Barnabas: No new identifiable depiction; removed v1 older travelling companion is not used as an identity anchor.
stableTraits.Stephen: Acts 6 Story: medium-brown adult with short dark curls, beard, lean build; no new portrait in Acts 7.
stableTraits.MaryJosephJohnTheBaptist: Earlier Matthew inventory read; no identifiable new Acts depiction. Joseph Barsabbas is not Jesus’s family member Joseph; apostle John is not John the Baptist.
stableTraits.Apostles: Acts 1 group is a partial view around lots; do not assign the grey central man to Peter, or infer all apostles/counts from visible figures. No new group portrait.

reason: Every new scene and both Story replacements avoid identifiable people; actual Genesis 7 style image supplied to each imagegen call.
